ui-elements-practice/a11y-findings.spec.ts
Known defects on the practice page
BUG: radio inputs have no accessible name (label[for] targets a non-existent id)
BUG: checkbox inputs have the same broken label[for] association
BUG: clicking the radio/checkbox label text does not toggle the control
BUG: two different tables share the same id="product"
BUG: the courses iframe has no accessible name
ui-elements-practice/alerts.spec.ts
Switch To Alert Example
alert asks for a name when the field is empty
alert greets the entered name
confirm dialog text changes based on whether a name was entered
dismissing confirm logs the Cancel branch to the console
accepting confirm logs the OK branch to the console
ui-elements-practice/autocomplete-input.spec.ts
Suggestion Class Example (autocomplete input)
shows the placeholder when empty
accepts free text input
ui-elements-practice/checkboxes.spec.ts
Checkbox Example
checkboxes toggle independently
none are checked by default
all three can be checked at once (unlike the radio group)
ui-elements-practice/dropdown.spec.ts
Dropdown Example
lists the expected options in order
defaults to the placeholder "Select" option
selecting an option by label updates the value
ui-elements-practice/fixed-header-table.spec.ts
Web Table Fixed Header Example
the displayed total matches the sum of the Amount column
lists all 9 rows even though only part of the table is visible
the header stays pinned to the top while the body scrolls
ui-elements-practice/hide-show.spec.ts
Element Displayed Example
the text field is visible on load
Hide removes the field and Show brings it back
clicking Hide twice keeps the field hidden
ui-elements-practice/iframe.spec.ts
iFrame Example
the iframe points at the expected src
the iframe eventually loads a document
ui-elements-practice/mouse-hover.spec.ts
Mouse Hover Example
the menu is hidden until the button is hovered
hovering reveals Top and Reload links
moving away hides the menu again

no radio is selected by default
clicking the label text does NOT check the radio (broken label association)

clicking opens a new tab instead of navigating the current page

Switch Window Example
opens example.com in a new window via window.open
